description: A mall buys two types of hand sanitizer machines, a motion activated one and a manual one. The motion activated one can deliver 50 drops per minute and consumes 30 kWh. The manual one can deliver 75 drops per minute and consumes 20 kWh. Since the motion activated one is more hygienic, at most 40% of the machines can be manual. In addition, at least 3 should be motion activated. If the mall must be able to deliver at least 1000 drops per minute and can use at most 500 kWh per minute, how many of each machine should they buy to minimize the total number of machines?

MotionActivatedDropRate.definition: Drop rate (drops per minute) of motion activated machine

MotionActivatedEnergyConsumption.definition: Energy consumption (kWh) of motion activated machine

ManualDropRate.definition: Drop rate (drops per minute) of manual machine

MaxManualPercentage.definition: Maximum percentage of machines that can be manual

MinMotionActivatedMachines.definition: Minimum number of motion activated machines

MinTotalDrops.definition: Minimum total drop delivery (drops per minute)

MaxTotalEnergy.definition: Maximum total energy consumption (kWh per minute)

objective.description: "Minimize the total number of hand sanitizer machines (motion activated and manual combined) purchased by the mall."

constraints.description: The number of motion activated machines must be an integer and at least 3
The number of manual machines must be a non-negative integer
The number of manual machines must be at most 40% of the total number of machines purchased
The total drop delivery per minute from all machines must be at least 1000 drops
The total energy consumption per minute from all machines must not exceed 500 kWh
